title: データサイエンス
subtitle: Data Science
keywords: Scientific calculation 2.Numerical analysis 3.Data visualization 4.Machine learning 5.Data mining
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Acquire how to conduct scientific computing. (2) Acquire how to conduct numerical analysis on a computer. (3) Acquire how to visualize data. (4) Understand the abstract of machine learning and acquire how to implement it on a computer. (5) Understand the abstract of data mining and get the ability to explain it.
advice: This course gives how to deal with data using a computer. Before joining this course, you should know the basics of Linear Algebra and Statistics. Moreover, you must make free 20GiB space on your computer before starting this course.
requiredKnowledge: (1) Knowledge of Linear Algebra (2) Knowledge of Statistics (3) Skills to implement some basic python programming

activityGoals.body: Be able to conduct scientific computing by a computer.
Be able to conduct numerical analysis by a computer.
Be able to explain data visualization.
Be able to implement a program based on Machine Learning.
Be able to explain the abstract of data mining.
